captions_note: the row sits over the chest band, so build.py writes work/reel_captions.json and the reel's captions step aside only while it is up
in_a_reel: FRAMES are stills of the user's own footage: 'aroll' (this slot) or paths to their own reels; quotes come from the matching words.json or are written by hand, never invented
F_IN 10 or later; the whole row up 18 frames or more before F_OUT; the row gone 2 frames before the slot ends
SCRIPT None = the words said in the slot
steps: edit the CLIP block in build.py: F_IN, F_OUT, FRAMES (clip, second, quote), SCRIPT, HIGHLIGHT
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the row, the frames and the snapshot times
